name: charter
title: Charter
description: A catalogue of chart and diagram types, showing which Mermaid, shadcn or ECharts can draw, with docs links, templates and prompt snippets one keystroke away
author: aic

commands.name: browse-charts
commands.title: Browse Charts
commands.subtitle: Charter
commands.description: Browse chart and diagram types by family, see which provider draws each one, and copy the docs link, template or prompt snippet

preferences.title: Chart Providers

preferences.label: shadcn
preferences.description: Show chart types shadcn ships a chart recipe for

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
